about_the_game:
intimate Swordplay
one of my main focuses in this game is to create a engaging close quarters combat system, no fancy cartwheel triple jumps that send your character 10 feet in the air or flashy 5 button combos, just close intimate swordplay. finding gaps in your opponents defenses before they find find a gap in yours. maneuver around shields, parry and deflect attack, and counter when you find an opening or create one yourself.


intercontinental Platformer/rpg
unlike most action-platformers and metroidvanias this game has a expansive RPG-like overworld with caves, forests, mountains, towns and dungeons with secrets, oddities and danger everywhere you go.


A Living World Under Duress
Im very passionate about making a world feel like a living breathing space, where every NPC, home, & village feels like a small part of a larger living, breathing world. there are secrets hidden behind every corner, people with routines and relationships, places with cultural beliefs and histories.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.2 ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 mb video memory
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space MB available space

short_description: SHEEP LAD is a grand scale Swashbuckling, Role-playing, Platforming Adventure Game, with a focus on combat, exploration, and surreal mysteries. Take on the Role of Basil the Sheep Lad as he journeys into a dangerous land Dungeoneering and Questing in search for his older sister
